Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, Advocate
for the petitioner in WPMS No. 1503 of 
2020.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the 
petitioner in WPMS No. 1664 of 2020.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Additional C.S.C. 
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Virendra Kaparwan, Standing 
Counsel for Union of India. 
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties through video conferencing. 
Counter affidavit filed on behalf of 
respondent no.1 in WPMS No. 1503 of 
2020 is taken on record. The misc. 
application (I.A. No. 12038 of 2021), 
made therefor, stands disposed of.
Substitution application (I.A. No. 
12037 of 2021) filed in WPMS No. 1503 
of 2020, being unopposed by learned 
counsel for the respondents, is allowed. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
to produce amended memo of parties in 
the Registry on or before 19.07.2021. 
This application (I.A. No. 12036 of 
2021) has been filed by Mr. Jogendra
Kumar Sahani with a prayer that he may 
be impleaded as petitioner no. 2 in 
WPMS No. 1503 of 2020. 
The ground taken in the 
impleadment application is that the sole 
petitioner, namely, Tarun Sahani has 
passed away on 24.05.2021. However, 
the fact of the matter is that an 
application for substitution of legal heirs  of Tarun Sahani has also been filed, 
which has been allowed, therefore, this 
Court does not find any reason to allow 
this impleadment application.
It is not the case of the applicant 
that he had given any power of attorney 
in favour of Tarun Sahani or that Tarun 
Sahani was looking after the affairs of 
the land in question.
Accordingly, the impleadment 
application is dismissed. However, 
applicant shall be at liberty to file an 
individual writ petition for ventilation of 
his grievance, if any. 
List these matters after three 
weeks. 
Pleadings be exchanged in the 
meantime.
Interim order, if any, to continue till 
then. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 13.07.2021
Arpan

WPMS No.1503 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, Advocate, for 
the petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Fartiyal, Deputy Advocate 
General, for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. V.K. Kapurwan, CGSC, for the 
Union of India.
IA No.12040 of 2022, filed by the 
petitioner along with the rejoinder affidavit, 
would stand allowed. Rejoinder affidavit is 
taken on record.
In relation to the proceedings, which are 
the subject matter of this writ petition, there 
happens to be a corresponding proceedings 
before the competent courts’ at Mumbai, but 
none of the counsels are in a position to inform
the Court as to what decision has been taken so 
far by the courts’ at Mumbai. 
They are directed to complete their
instructions and provide the necessary 
information about the decision taken in the 
matter in Mumbai courts, by the next date 
fixed.
List this writ petition in the week 
commencing 20.06.2022.
Respondent No.4, as well as the State, is 
granted further three weeks’ time to file counter 
affidavit.
Interim order already granted would 
continue to operate till the next date of listing. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
05.05.2022
NR/

WPMS No. 1503 of 2020
In 
WPMS No. 1664 of 2020 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Atul Kumar Bansal, Advocate, for the 
petitioner in WPMS No. 1503 of 2020.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate, for the petitioner 
in WPMS No. 1664 of 2020. 
Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, Standing Counsel, for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, Standing Counsel, for 
the Union of India. 
Since from the records, it seems that some 
parallel proceedings are going on before the 
Mumbai Court, this Court by an order of 5th May, 
2022, had directed the respondents to complete the 
instructions pertaining to the stages and status of 
the proceeding before the Courts at Mumbai. The 
information has not yet been completed. 
Hence, the learned counsel for the Union of 
India, seeks an adjournment for a week, in order to 
comply the order dated 5th May, 2022. 
Put up these Writ Petitions in the next week. 
Interim order already granted would continue 
to operate till the next date of listing. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 20.06.2022
Shiv
